title: Meditate, Meditate, Meditate In Remembrance Of Him,
summary: Anxiety is named plainly here before the mind has time to decorate it.
takeaway: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace
lifeApplication: Read one line aloud before trying to solve the whole future. Begin with the part of the day already in front of you.

source.shortMeaning: Meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace
source.lifeApplication: Anxiety becomes more truthful when meditate, meditate, meditate in remembrance of Him, and find peace.
